listingTitle: Respect reduced-motion preferences for spatial motion
title: Respect reduced-motion preferences for spatial motion
why: Movement and scaling effects can trigger vestibular symptoms when a user has requested reduced motion.
suggestion: Disable or replace spatial animations and transitions inside a prefers-reduced-motion media query.
limitations: A reduced-motion media query anywhere in the file is treated as the file-level guard.
Cosmetic color, shadow, and opacity transitions are not reported.
